description: This file is a Jupyter notebook containing tutorial code for using liteLLM to perform streaming inference with multiple language models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Replicate, Cohere). It installs the library, sets environment variables for API keys, initializes messages, defines models, and calls the completion function to stream responses from various models.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Function from the litellm library used to send a prompt to a language model and receive a streaming response.
